classifications.DIRECT: Same meaning and value format; sent under the NSR key.
classifications.ALIAS: The spec lists the DataBridge key as an accepted alias; sent under the NSR key.
classifications.TRANSFORMED: Value converted to the documented NSR value.
classifications.DERIVED: Computed from DataBridge values without inventing data.
classifications.MISSING: DataBridge does not collect this; never sent.
classifications.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Needs confirmation from the NSR team (value vocabulary, meaning or format).

household.notes: The household head's DataBridge record ID.
Grouping key for the household.

Build-sheet sponsors (UNICEF, GIZ, NG CARES, State, AfDB, WFP, Others) do not match the NSR list. Mapped provisionally: State -> STATE_GOVERNMENT, Others -> OTHER, the rest -> DEVELOPMENT_PARTNER (NG CARES is federal, World Bank financed: confirm). If absent, NSR records FEDERAL_GOVERNMENT.
Always sent. A household is blocked unless every member record has consent_to_share_data = true. The NSR default "YES" is never relied on.
coordinate_source is deliberately NOT sent: NSR would read it ("NSR field enumeration") as the enumerator name. If enumerator_id is absent, NSR records "CCT_DATABRIDGE".
The build sheet merges enumerator and unlisted enumerator into enumerator_id.
Mandatory in DataBridge, so the NSR default is not reached.

Sent as latitude, longitude, accuracy_m for NSR to format. DataBridge has no altitude, so it does not build the "lat lon alt acc" string itself. If coordinates are absent, NSR records "0.0 0.0 0.0 0.0" (a real point at sea): confirm NSR can leave it empty.
Must equal the number of member records grouped under the household, or the household is blocked.
Meaning not documented and no build-sheet field. Not sent, so NSR records "YES".
